name: Banh day
summary: A Mong Tết cake from upland sticky rice. Vietnamnet says it is pounded smooth by hand, wrapped in forest dong leaves, and kept, especially in the cold at the start of spring. Eat it with chả or giò, grill it, or dip it in forest honey. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, following Gia đình & Xã hội, ties the cake to Mong Tết. A stall outside Tết is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Steam the upland rice, pound it smooth by hand, and wrap it in forest dong leaves. Vietnamnet says the work is manual and slow, and that the cake keeps a long time.
Eat it with chả or giò, grill it over charcoal, or dip it in forest honey. A price is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Tết is the occasion Vietnamnet names. Check on arrival outside that.
seoTitle: Banh day in Dien Bien Phu — Mong Tết cake
seoDescription: Mong Tết cake of upland sticky rice, pounded and wrapped in forest dong leaves. With chả, grilled, or with forest honey. A price is Check on arrival.
